body_html:
Yes and this is being sent from the Indigenous app to @withknown using Micropub, an #indieweb tech baked into the tools we use.

If you have the plugins installed you should be able to POSSE to Twitter (not Facebook soon) but I think @chrisaldrich uses a plug in called SNAP and not bridgy, webmentions, and semantic linkback (all plug ins included in the indieweb plug in).

You are using 100% compatible theme in your sandbox. That helps. Even my theme glitches webmentions when something updates
